Survivor 3D Test

The Farmer, made from one ChatGPT drawing turned into a 3D model, rigged and rendered to 128-px sprites. Weapons are attached to the hand bone, so switching them re-equips every frame of every animation.

In the town

Two Farmers walk loops, turning at each corner so all four directions show; two more chop in place. The town is the ink mockup at the scale where its own villagers match the sprites. Equip changes every Farmer at once.

Building

Rotate

Same camera and lighting as the Farmer (the game's exact 2:1 tile angle), same pixels per metre, so the size against him is what the game would show. Each rotation is the 3D model turned, so the back view is a real back. Tap the scene or Turn 90° to rotate.
